original_local_details: R4-LOCAL-BERTH-DUTY is an original bounded local public landing function, not an operator, recruited character or laboratory permission.
The chart handoff binds the actual single GLIMMER, Q304 typed mining handover, its MC-2 original source versions and unique carried sealed sample, and the exact formal materials/signatory inquiry.
Issuance requires the actual source berth, registered three cabins, physical HUB-S02 chart stand and paired safe R4-S01 public route. It adds no weather, tide, distance or invented sailing task.

Registration grants no laboratory, deposited-sample result, experiment output, current mentor state, reward or future document. Travel sailing, actual arrival and local custody deposit remain separate commands.
The original handover preserves association requiring verification and unknown current mentor status. Its scope never licenses a favorable experimental conclusion or absolution.
